decisionEvents.ret: "Hey." Kelly settles near you, not too close. "Day one. Everyone's pretending they're fine. ...Can we talk? Just talk — like people used to."
"What do you make of all this? Really."

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
«Hallo! Du... wie heißt du?»
"Did you sleep? I kept hearing things out past the treeline."
"I'm going hungry — have you got anything to spare? Anything? I can't keep going like this."
"What's something from your old life that's actually useful here? Simple as that."
"What's your first memory? Like, ever. The earliest thing."
"Can we talk?" Natalia sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"You talk to it -- the System. Have you ever asked? About the taken -- about Patrick?"
"About the food I needed — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About your useful old-life skills — What's something from your old life that's actually useful here?"

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
They speak. You understand none of it.
Natalia: "Don't just stand there — you've got opinions, right?"
"I don't know what to do with my hands today."
"Please — I can't shake it. I'm feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. I need help. Please."
"About the sickness I'm fighting — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"Never mind the food I needed — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"About the sickness I'm fighting — still need hands. Are you in?"
"We're eating through stores faster than we replace them. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"The pantry's nearly bare. Come forage with me tomorrow — two of us can fill packs."
"About the pantry run — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
They speak. You understand none of it. "Food?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
(They mime walking — pointing at themselves, then at you, then toward the trap line. The meaning is unmistakable: come with me.)
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"About the pantry run — I still haven't found anyone. Any chance?"
"About the pantry run — I hate to ask twice, but it's still open. Will you?"
"About the pantry run — still need hands. Are you in?"

Sanne speaks only 🇩🇪 German. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
They speak. You understand none of it. "Okay?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
(They mime walking — pointing at themselves, then at you, then toward the tree line. The meaning is unmistakable: come with me.)
"Look at the fire — see how it's leaning? Wind's changing."
"I keep dreaming about rows of pods. Humming. Tell me I'm not the only one."
"I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"About this wound — the need hasn't gone anywhere. I'm still asking."
"About what happened to my taken kin — Have you heard anything? About the taken. The pods. Anything at all."
"Honestly? Can I tell you something? I don't actually know how to swim and I'm terrified someone will find out."
"I asked Diana about the pantry run — Diana's gone. Still need hands. Are you in?"
"I hate to ask this, but I'm feverish, a cut gone hot and angry. I need help. Please."
"Can we talk?" Luis sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to."
"Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago. ...never mind."
"The pantry run — I haven't stopped thinking about it."
I'll do what it takes. I'll live with what I've done. That's the deal.
"About what day it is — Do you still count the days? I lost track days ago. You know?"
People need to know someone's got a plan. Even if the plan is 'we'll figure it out.'
"Don't mind me. Today's just heavy."

Artyom speaks only 🇷🇺 Russian. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
«Эй... говоришь по-русски? Нет? ...чёрт.»
(They mime walking — pointing at themselves, then at you, then toward the tree line. The meaning is unmistakable: come with me.)
"Never mind the sickness I'm fighting — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. I can't reach this properly. Could you clean it out for me? Please."
"They'd tell me to keep working. So I'm working. That's the whole plan."
"We gave them a good burial. Doesn't feel like enough, does it?"
"I keep expecting to see them by the fire. Then I remember."
"Never mind this wound — we got it handled. Thanks anyway."
"Fine — Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing."
I'm not dying for anyone's principles. I do what keeps me breathing. Remember that.
"Never mind the pantry run — we got it handled. Thanks anyway. This wound — I can't clean it properly one-handed. Could you take a look?"
"So what's your plan here? Just... get through it?"
"Have you — sorry. I keep thinking about them."

Fatima speaks only 🇮🇳 Hindi. No shared words at all — just eyes, hands, and patience.
«नमस्ते! तुम्हारा नाम क्या है?» "Hello?" — they grin, proud of the one English they know.
"It's quiet today. Wrong kind of quiet."
"I asked Zhanibek about whether you still sing — Zhanibek's gone. Do you still sing? ...Sorry — weird question. I just realized I haven't heard anyone sing. Hm."

sayLines.line: Your scars ITCH — and hold. You should be down, but the scars remember every almost-death and refuse a new one. (Scar Tissue: held at 25% HP.)

💛 You hold Field suture kit. You practiced on an orange. 'People are just oranges that bleed,' your instructor said, and then taught you how to not flinch. You haven't flinched since. Your gifts are not mastered — but they are lived-in, and they are with you. The feast was the weapon. 📺 🎙️ PLAY-BY-PLAY: And we are LIVE with a special presentation: THE FEAST! The little ones are putting flavored matter in their mouths ON PURPOSE. For joy. The file says joy.

🍖 FEAST 📺 — Diana opens the pantry wide: 12× Foraged food. George, Zhanibek, Natalia eat until the fire burns low. Nobody says what this cost — everybody knows. For one evening, the pantry is lighter and the people are not. (−2,400 kcal from the pantry) Tom stayed in their tent, feverish; Nino stayed in their tent, feverish. The channeled keepsake feeds the feast — the feast was the weapon, and the surge rides the fire until tomorrow's dawn, spent only when the blades are warmed. (FEAST SURGE ×1.5 armed)
